description: Fix the print shop queue report whose string sort scatters the loading dock's slash-dated jobs to both ends. DISTILL-CANARY-d239875e

files.queue.py:
"""Print the job queue report for Ironpress Printworks.

The shop system drops one file per month into jobs/, one row per job:

    job_id,added_on,copies

The queue report is one line per job, oldest first, followed by a line
counting the jobs:

    <added_on>,<job_id>
    QUEUED,<jobs>

Days are printed exactly as the shop system wrote them.
"""

import csv
import glob

rows = []
for path in sorted(glob.glob("jobs/*.csv")):
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        rows.extend(list(csv.reader(handle))[1:])
rows.sort(key=lambda row: row[1])
for row in rows:
    print(f"{row[1]},{row[0]}")
print(f"QUEUED,{len(rows)}")

# Ironpress Printworks - job queue report

The shop system drops one file per month into jobs/. Two terminals write
the added_on column: the front desk writes 2026-09-26 style days, the
loading dock writes day-first slashes like 26/09/2026. Both mean the same
day.
